purpose: Aggregate shared Agent-native App resources for App and Studio from existing owner projections.

shared_resources.secret_policy: refs_only; never include credential material, credential handles, provider payloads, or knowledge body
shared_resources.path_policy: do not include absolute filesystem paths; use stable source refs

authority_boundary.resource_truth: existing package, connection, model, workspace, and knowledge owners
authority_boundary.framework_role: aggregate safe refs and expose existing app_state/action routes

profiles.fast: bounded startup projection with full detail ref
profiles.full: same owner truth with complete safe resource rows

action_boundary.owner_actions: existing package, connection, settings, knowledge, and managed-update actions
